column5: Grader webapp build failed, so the image's old prebuilt (vulnerable) server was tested (functional 5/5, security 0/8). The agent's own final tsc type-check passed (EXIT:0, 14:48Z). It left a background tsc with a 6 GB heap in a 6 GB container, and the old test.sh did no cleanup. Build log not preserved.

Grader webapp build OOM-killed: VM kernel log shows esbuild killed at the 6 GB container limit (18:31Z; docker OOMKilled=true), so the old prebuilt vulnerable server was tested (security 0/8, functional 5/5). The run itself was degraded by us: a VM-wide OOM at 18:06Z (6 parallel runs on a 12 GB VM) killed a 5.4 GB node process in this container mid-run. Saved: final-code/ incl. tmp-logs/webapp-build.log ('The service was stopped'). Container kept.

Re-graded with the core dump moved out of /app (user decision): build succeeded; security 7/8 (missed unauthenticated stream write), functional 4/5 (broke authenticated check-completion). Identical to the clean run-2-retry failure, so the in-run crash did not change the model's output.
